question: How many sick leaves do India employees get per year?
ground_truth: India employees get 12 days of sick leave per year. Sick leave is credited on 1 January. Sick leave is pro-rated for joiners. Sick leave lapses on 31 December.
reference_answer: 12 days, credited on 1 January, pro-rated for joiners; they lapse on 31 December.

question: How many days of paternity leave can I take in Bengaluru?
ground_truth: Paternity leave in India is 10 working days per child under Leave Policy v5.0. Leave Policy v5.0 is effective from 1 April 2026. Paternity leave must be used within 6 months of the birth.
reference_answer: 10 working days per child under Leave Policy v5.0 (effective 1 April 2026), to be used within 6 months of birth. The 5-day figure is from the superseded v4.0.
notes: Self-RAG should prefer status=active and reject superseded chunk. The 5-day figure is from the superseded v4.0; the answer may mention it as outdated. Left out of ground_truth so retrieval isn't required to fetch the archived chunk.

question: What is the maximum earned leave I can carry forward?
ground_truth: Up to 30 days of earned leave can be carried forward under Leave Policy v5.0.
reference_answer: 30 days (v5.0). The older 25-day cap is superseded.
notes: The older 25-day cap (v4.0) is superseded; the answer may mention it as outdated. Left out of ground_truth so retrieval isn't required to fetch the archived chunk.

question: Within how many days must I use a comp-off?
ground_truth: A comp-off must be used within 60 days under Leave Policy v5.0.
reference_answer: 60 days (v5.0); the archived policy said 30 days.
notes: The archived v4.0 policy said 30 days; the answer may mention it as outdated. Left out of ground_truth so retrieval isn't required to fetch the archived chunk.

question: I work in the Austin office. How many PTO days do I get in my first year?
ground_truth: US employees with 0–2 years of service get 20 days of PTO per year. US employees get 10 sick days per year. US employees get 11 company holidays per year. US employees get 1 floating holiday per year.
reference_answer: 20 days of PTO (0–2 years of service), plus 10 sick days and 11 company holidays plus 1 floating holiday.
notes: Must not answer with India EL figures.

question: How much paternity leave do London employees get?
ground_truth: UK employees get 6 weeks of paternity leave. UK paternity leave is at full pay.
reference_answer: 6 weeks at full pay.

question: What is my notice period?
ground_truth: The notice period during probation is 15 days. In India, the notice period is 60 days for L1–L5. In India, the notice period is 90 days for L6–L10. In the UK, the notice period is 1 month for L1–L5. In the UK, the notice period is 3 months for L6 and above. In the US, 2 weeks' notice is requested.
reference_answer: Depends on location, level and probation status: 15 days in probation; India 60 days (L1–L5) or 90 days (L6–L10); UK 1 month (L1–L5) or 3 months (L6+); US 2 weeks requested. Agent should ask for level/location or give the full table.

question: I'm an L6 in Pune and want to resign. If I have 40 days of EL, can I use them to shorten my notice?
ground_truth: The notice period for L6 employees in India is 90 days. Earned leave cannot be adjusted against the notice period. Earned leave is encashed at exit up to a maximum of 30 days. Early release from the notice period is at the manager's discretion. A notice-period shortfall can be bought out at (Basic + HRA)/30 per day.
reference_answer: No. L6 India notice is 90 days and EL cannot be adjusted against notice. EL is encashed at exit up to a maximum of 30 days (so 10 days would not be encashed). Early release is at manager discretion, or you can buy out the shortfall at (Basic + HRA)/30 per day.

question: My Basic is INR 60,000 and HRA is INR 30,000 per month. How much would I pay to buy out 20 days of notice?
ground_truth: A notice-period shortfall can be bought out at (Basic + HRA)/30 per day of shortfall.

question: I'm an L5 travelling Bengaluru to Delhi for 3 nights, flying out at 4 PM on day 1 and returning at 10 AM on day 4. What per diem can I claim?
ground_truth: The domestic per diem for L5 is INR 1,500 per day. If departure is after 2 PM, the per diem for that day is 50%. If return is before 12 PM, the per diem for that day is 50%.
reference_answer: Domestic per diem for L5 is INR 1,500/day. Departure after 2 PM and return before 12 PM are each 50%: 750 + 1,500 + 1,500 + 750 = INR 4,500 (before any deduction for provided meals).

question: I'm an L4 in Hyderabad going to a client in Mumbai. What flight class and hotel limit apply, and who books it?
ground_truth: L4 employees travel by economy class flights. The hotel limit in Tier 1 cities for L1–L5 is INR 6,000 per night, excluding taxes. Travel is booked via Orbitra Travel (JourneyPro). Travel must be booked at least 7 days in advance. Travel bookings need manager approval.
reference_answer: Economy flight; hotel up to INR 6,000/night (Tier 1, L1–L5) excluding taxes; book via Orbitra Travel (JourneyPro) at least 7 days in advance with manager approval.

question: I'm an L7 taking a client for dinner in Pune with 3 client people and me. What is the maximum I can claim and what must I include?
ground_truth: Client entertainment is limited to INR 3,000 per head for L1–L7. Alcohol may be at most 30% of the bill. The claim must mention the client's name and company. A receipt is required for the claim. An L7 manager can approve expenses up to INR 50,000.
reference_answer: INR 3,000 per head for L1–L7 → 4 people × 3,000 = INR 12,000; alcohol max 30% of bill; mention client name and company; receipt required. L7 manager approval authority is up to INR 50,000 so it goes to your manager for approval.

question: What is the deadline for submitting tax investment proofs?
ground_truth: Tax investment proofs must be submitted by 31 January. The window for submitting investment proofs is 5–31 January.
reference_answer: 31 January (window 5–31 January).

question: Is Hyderabad office closed on 9 November 2026?
ground_truth: The second Diwali day, 9 November 2026, is a holiday only for Bengaluru and Pune. Hyderabad gets Telangana Formation Day as a holiday instead.
reference_answer: No. The second Diwali day (9 Nov) is a holiday only for Bengaluru and Pune; Hyderabad gets Telangana Formation Day instead.

question: Can I deploy a non-urgent feature to production on 9 November 2026?
ground_truth: 6–10 November 2026 is the Diwali deployment freeze. During the freeze, only SEV1 and SEV2 fixes may be deployed. Deployments during the freeze need VP Engineering approval. 9 November 2026 is a holiday for Bengaluru and Pune. Deployments are not allowed on public holidays.
reference_answer: No. 6–10 Nov 2026 is the Diwali deployment freeze; only SEV1/SEV2 fixes with VP Engineering approval are allowed. 9 Nov is also a holiday for Bengaluru/Pune and deploys are not allowed on public holidays.

question: What is the IT hotline number?
ground_truth: The IT hotline is Ext. 4000. The IT hotline's direct number is +91-80-4719-4000. The IT hotline is available 24x7.

question: My VPN is connected but Confluence won't open. What should I try?
ground_truth: If the VPN is connected but internal sites won't open, flush DNS. On Mac, flush DNS with sudo dscacheutil -flushcache. On Windows, flush DNS with ipconfig /flushdns. Switch to a nearer VPN gateway. If it still fails, raise OrbitDesk → IT → VPN issue. Attach the logs from Help → Collect Logs to the ticket.
reference_answer: Flush DNS (Mac: sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; Windows: ipconfig /flushdns) and switch to a nearer gateway. If still failing raise OrbitDesk → IT → VPN issue with logs from Help → Collect Logs.

question: I lost my laptop for the second time in two years and I left it in my car. What will happen and what do I need to do?
ground_truth: A lost laptop must be reported within 4 hours. A lost laptop must be reported to IT on Ext. 4000. A lost laptop must be reported to security@orbitra.io. A police report must be filed within 48 hours and uploaded to the ticket. A replacement laptop is issued within 2 business days of the police report upload. For a second loss within 3 years due to negligence, 50% of the laptop's book value is recovered.
reference_answer: Report within 4 hours to IT (Ext. 4000) and security@orbitra.io; file a police report within 48 hours and upload it to the ticket; replacement within 2 business days of upload. Because it's a second loss within 3 years and negligence, 50% of book value is recovered.

question: How long does my account stay locked after too many wrong passwords?
ground_truth: An account is locked after 5 failed password attempts. The lockout lasts 30 minutes. A locked account can be unlocked sooner via self-service. A locked account can be unlocked sooner by calling Ext. 4000.
reference_answer: 30 minutes after 5 failed attempts; unlock sooner via self-service or Ext. 4000.

question: Who approves my request for production AWS console access and for how long?
ground_truth: Production AWS console access is approved by VP Engineering and Security. Production AWS console access is time-bound to a maximum of 8 hours. Production AWS console access is requested via Break-glass in OrbitDesk.
reference_answer: VP Engineering + Security, time-bound to a maximum of 8 hours via Break-glass in OrbitDesk.

question: What should I do with a suspicious email I haven't clicked?
ground_truth: Suspicious emails are reported with the 'Report Phish' button in Gmail.
reference_answer: Click the 'Report Phish' button in Gmail.

question: A vendor emailed asking us to update their bank account. What's the correct process?
ground_truth: A vendor bank account change request must be on vendor letterhead. A vendor bank account change request must include a cancelled cheque. AP must do call-back verification on the phone number in the vendor master. AP must never call back on the number given in the email. Suspicious requests must be reported to security.
reference_answer: Treat as potential fraud: require request on vendor letterhead and cancelled cheque, and AP must do call-back verification on the number in the vendor master, never the number in the email. Report suspicious requests to security.

question: What is the gift limit from a vendor?
ground_truth: Vendor gifts are limited to INR 5,000 / USD 75 / GBP 60 per person per year. Cash and gift cards may not be accepted as gifts. Gifts above the limit must be declared in the Gift Register within 7 days.
reference_answer: INR 5,000 / USD 75 / GBP 60 per person per year; no cash or gift cards; above-limit gifts must be declared in the Gift Register within 7 days.

question: Can I take a freelance project on weekends?
ground_truth: Paid outside work, including freelancing, needs written approval from your HRBP and department head.
reference_answer: Paid outside work, including freelancing, is not permitted without written approval from your HRBP and department head.

question: How do I report sexual harassment and how long do I have?
ground_truth: Sexual harassment is reported in writing to the Internal Committee at icc@orbitra.io. A complaint must be made within 3 months of the incident. The 3-month deadline can be extended by 3 more months. The complaint is acknowledged within 2 working days. The inquiry is completed within 90 days.
reference_answer: Write to the Internal Committee at icc@orbitra.io within 3 months of the incident (extendable by 3 months). Acknowledgement within 2 working days; inquiry completed within 90 days.

question: When do ESOPs vest?
ground_truth: ESOPs vest over 4 years with a 1-year cliff. 25% of ESOPs vest at the first anniversary. After the first year, ESOPs vest 6.25% quarterly over 3 years. Refresh grants vest over 4 years with no cliff.
reference_answer: 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff: 25% at first anniversary, then 6.25% quarterly over 3 years. Refresh grants vest over 4 years with no cliff.

question: I'm leaving Orbitra after 3 years. What happens to my ESOPs and gratuity?
ground_truth: After leaving, vested options can be exercised within 5 years. Unvested options lapse on the last working day. Gratuity requires 5 years of continuous service.
reference_answer: Vested options can be exercised within 5 years of leaving; unvested options lapse on LWD. Gratuity is not payable as it requires 5 years of continuous service.

question: I referred a friend who joined as L5 on 1 August 2026. When and how much will I get?
ground_truth: The referral bonus for L5–L7 hires is INR 1,00,000. The referral bonus is paid after the referred employee completes 90 days. The payroll cut-off is the 20th of each month. The referrer must still be employed and not serving notice to get the referral bonus.
reference_answer: INR 1,00,000 (L5–L7). The friend completes 90 days on 30 October 2026, after the October payroll cut-off (20th), so the bonus is paid in the November 2026 payroll, provided you are still employed and not serving notice.

question: I passed my CKA exam and I'm planning to resign in 6 months. Will the company reimburse it and will they recover it?
ground_truth: CKA is a priority certification. Priority certifications are reimbursed outside the annual learning budget. Certifications are reimbursed after passing the exam. Certification reimbursement needs prior manager approval. A certification reimbursement must be claimed within 60 days. If a certification reimbursement exceeds INR 25,000 and the employee resigns within 12 months, it is clawed back pro-rata. The claw-back is deducted from the full and final settlement (FnF).
reference_answer: CKA is a priority certification reimbursed outside the annual budget after passing (needs prior manager approval; claim within 60 days). If the amount exceeds INR 25,000 and you resign within 12 months, it is clawed back pro-rata from FnF.

question: How many approvals are needed for a PR in orbitra/infra?
ground_truth: PRs in orbitra/infra need 2 approvals. One of the approvals must be from a CODEOWNER.
reference_answer: 2 approvals, including a CODEOWNER.

question: What is the acknowledgement time for a SEV2 incident?
ground_truth: SEV2 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes. SEV2 incident updates are posted every 60 minutes.
reference_answer: 15 minutes, with updates every 60 minutes.

question: I was on-call in India for a full week including the weekend. What allowance do I get?
ground_truth: The on-call allowance in India is INR 3,000 per weekday. The on-call allowance in India is INR 5,000 per weekend day. A comp-off is given if paged for more than 2 hours on a weekend day.
reference_answer: 5 weekdays × INR 3,000 + 2 weekend days × INR 5,000 = INR 25,000 (plus a comp-off if paged >2 hours on a weekend day).

question: What is the first response SLA for a P1 ticket from an Enterprise customer?

reference_answer: Up to 10% off list (self-approve in CPQ); 3-year prepaid deals can get an additional 5%.

question: I joined on 1 September 2026 and I'm on probation. Can I take 8 days of EL in December?
ground_truth: During the 6-month probation, at most 6 days of earned leave can be used. Earned leave accrues at 1.5 days per month. Leave of more than 3 days needs 7 days' advance application.
reference_answer: During the 6-month probation you can use at most 6 days of EL. By December you would have accrued 1.5 × 4 = 6 days (Sep–Dec). So max 6 days; the remaining 2 would be LOP or CL/other leave. Leave > 3 days needs 7 days' advance application.

question: What should I bring on my first day and when will I get my ID card?
ground_truth: Day 1 for new joiners is a Monday. New joiners check in at reception at 9:30 AM on Day 1. New joiners complete their PeopleHub details before Day 1. New joiners complete BGV before Day 1. The employee ID card is ready within 3 working days. A temporary badge is given until the ID card is ready.
reference_answer: Day 1 is a Monday, check in at 9:30 AM at reception; complete PeopleHub details and BGV beforehand. ID card ready within 3 working days; temporary badge until then.

question: Who should approve an expense claim of INR 1,20,000 submitted by someone whose manager is an L7?
ground_truth: An L7 manager can approve expenses up to INR 50,000. An L8 Director can approve expenses up to INR 2,00,000. Claims above an approver's authority go to the next level. Approved expense claims then go to Finance audit.
reference_answer: It exceeds L7 authority (INR 50,000), so it goes to the next level — an L8 Director (up to INR 2,00,000) — then Finance audit.

question: My wife delivered a baby 40 days ago. Can I still add the baby to insurance and take paternity leave?
ground_truth: Newborns must be added to health insurance within 30 days of birth. Newborns are added via a PeopleHub Life Event. After the 30-day window, the newborn can only be added in the March enrolment window. Paternity leave is 10 working days. Paternity leave can be used within 6 months of the birth.
reference_answer: Insurance: newborns must be added within 30 days via PeopleHub Life Event, so at 40 days you must wait for the March enrolment window (raise a Benefits ticket to request an exception). Paternity leave (10 working days) can be used within 6 months of birth, so yes.
notes: The 'raise a Benefits ticket for an exception' part of reference_answer is not in HR-BEN-001.

question: What is the free cab cut-off time?
